column1: # Vietnamese (vi) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms: Vietnamese has one (`plural_none`), so @plural rows carry a single translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label for ERPCons
# Văn phòng. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI (Acrobat's
# included) was consulted or copied; tool and command names use the vocabulary Vietnamese users
# know from office software; terms follow erpcons-office/docs/glossary-vi.md.
# Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, JavaScript ...) are not translated;
# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
